document: MIMO_LEARNER_STATE_SCHEMA — Mimo 9.35 real persisted learner state
note: All values are naturally generated by the original app on a fresh emulator. The phase-3/4 restore copied this same natural private tree (82 files, 2 lesson_progress rows) before launch; no synthetic learner rows were inserted.

schema_sql.name: chapter_completions
schema_sql.sql: CREATE TABLE `chapter_completions` (`chapter_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL, `track_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `tutorial_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`chapter_id`, `track_id`))

schema_sql.name: lesson_progress
schema_sql.sql: CREATE TABLE `lesson_progress` (`lesson_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `completed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL, `started_at` INTEGER NOT NULL, `tries` INTEGER NOT NULL, `tutorial_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `tutorial_version` INTEGER NOT NULL, `track_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `publish_set_version` INTEGER NOT NULL, `attempts` INTEGER NOT NULL, `is_practice_progress` INTEGER NOT NULL, `in_queue` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`lesson_id`, `tutorial_id`))

schema_sql.name: room_master_table
schema_sql.sql: CREATE TABLE room_master_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,identity_hash TEXT)

schema_sql.name: tutorial_completions
schema_sql.sql: CREATE TABLE `tutorial_completions` (`tutorial_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `is_completed` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL, `track_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`tutorial_id`, `track_id`))

lesson_progress.writer: LessonProgressRepository.createLessonProgress(LessonBundle, Instant, I, I) -> LessonProgressQueue.storeLessonProgress -> Room INSERT OR REPLACE
